_note: Chapter 16 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The manager was accused of abusing his authority to win the contract.
ex.cn: 经理被指控滥用职权来拿下这份合同。
ex.note: abuse one's power 滥用权力；drug abuse 滥用药物

ex.en: The old battery leaked acid onto the shelf.
ex.cn: 那节旧电池漏出的酸液沾到了架子上。

ex.en: Her comment about the design was rather acid.
ex.cn: 她对那个设计的评论相当尖刻。
ex.note: acid rain 酸雨；an acid tone 尖刻的口气

ex.en: Only adults are allowed to use the workshop after eight o'clock.
ex.cn: 八点以后只有成年人才能使用那间工作室。

ex.en: The course is designed for adult learners who work during the day.
ex.cn: 这门课是为白天上班的成年学习者设计的。
ex.note: adult education 成人教育

ex.en: The university has a long tradition in agriculture and food science.
ex.cn: 这所大学在农业与食品科学方面有着悠久的传统。

ex.en: The kitchen is fitted with aluminium cabinets and a steel sink.
ex.cn: 厨房装的是铝合金橱柜和一个不锈钢水槽。

ex.en: The annual report shows a steady rise in sales.
ex.cn: 年度报告显示销售额稳步上升。

ex.en: The club publishes a small annual every December.
ex.cn: 俱乐部每年十二月出一本小年刊。
ex.note: annual meeting 年会；annual report 年报

ex.en: Each applicant had to write a short statement of purpose.
ex.cn: 每位申请人都要写一份简短的目的说明。

ex.en: A painted arrow points the way to the main hall.
ex.cn: 一个画上去的箭头指向主楼的方向。

ex.en: She joined the astronomy club to learn how to use a small telescope.
ex.cn: 她加入天文社，是为了学会使用一台小望远镜。

ex.en: Try to avoid parking on the narrow road outside the gate.
ex.cn: 尽量别把车停在门外那条窄路上。
ex.note: avoid doing sth. 避免做某事

ex.en: We ate at a small bar near the station.
ex.cn: 我们在车站附近一家小酒吧吃了东西。

ex.en: He barred the door against the wind and held it shut.
ex.cn: 他闩上门挡住风，把它牢牢按住。
ex.note: bar sb. from doing 阻止某人做

ex.en: She could not bear to hear the news a second time.
ex.cn: 她再也听不下去这个消息了。

ex.en: A brown bear appeared at the edge of the camp.
ex.cn: 一头棕熊出现在营地边缘。
ex.note: bear the pain 忍受痛苦；bear in mind 记住

ex.en: He sat on a bench under the old oak tree.
ex.cn: 他坐在老橡树下的长凳上。
ex.note: work bench 工作台

ex.en: The teacher wrote three questions on the blackboard.
ex.cn: 老师在黑板上写了三个问题。

ex.en: The little shop enjoyed a sudden boom during the tourist season.
ex.cn: 那家小店在旅游旺季突然红火了一阵。
ex.note: a boom in … …的繁荣；boom and bust 繁荣与萧条

ex.en: She took a deep breath and started to climb.
ex.cn: 她深深吸了一口气，开始往上爬。
ex.note: hold one's breath 屏住呼吸；out of breath 气喘吁吁

ex.en: The old wiring burned through before anyone noticed.
ex.cn: 旧电线烧断了，却没有人察觉。

ex.en: He had a burn on his hand from the hot pan.
ex.cn: 他的手被热锅烫出了一块灼伤。
ex.note: burn out 烧坏；burn through 烧穿

ex.en: We set up camp near the river before dark.
ex.cn: 天黑前我们在河边扎营。

ex.en: They camped on the beach for two weeks last summer.
ex.cn: 去年夏天他们在海滩上露营了两周。
ex.note: refugee camp 难民营；go camping 去露营

ex.en: They pushed the loaded cart across the square to the store.
ex.cn: 他们把装满书的手推车推过广场，运向书库。
ex.note: shopping cart 购物车

ex.en: The old workshop had been standing for nearly a century.
ex.cn: 那间老作坊已经立了近一个世纪。

ex.en: His cheerful face put the whole crew at ease.
ex.cn: 他那张乐呵呵的脸让整个班组都放松了下来。
ex.note: cheerful and cooperative 开朗而乐于配合

ex.en: A break in the circuit stopped the whole machine.
ex.cn: 电路上一处断点让整台机器停了。
ex.note: electric circuit 电路；go on a circuit 巡回一圈

ex.en: The campus clinic reported a sharp rise in flu cases.
ex.cn: 校医院报告流感病例急剧上升。
ex.note: dental clinic 牙科诊所

ex.en: A large colony of penguins nests on the rocky shore.
ex.cn: 一大群企鹅在多礁石的海岸上筑巢。
ex.note: a colony of ants 一群蚂蚁；former colony 殖民地

ex.en: Compare the two graphs before you decide which design to keep.
ex.cn: 在你决定保留哪个方案之前，先比较这两张图表。
ex.note: compare A with B 把A与B作比较；compared to 与…相比

ex.en: The rising cost of transport was their greatest concern.
ex.cn: 运输成本上涨是他们最大的忧虑。

ex.en: This decision concerns everyone who lives on the campus.
ex.cn: 这个决定关系到所有住在校园里的人。
ex.note: be concerned about 关心；concern oneself with 关心

ex.en: The student council gave its consent to the plan.
ex.cn: 学生委员会同意了这个计划。
ex.note: give consent to 同意；with the consent of 经…同意

ex.en: The seminar will continue for another hour.
ex.cn: 讲座还要再继续一个小时。
ex.note: continue to do 继续做；continue doing 继续做

ex.en: Their biggest worry was competition from larger corporate buyers.
ex.cn: 他们最大的担心是来自更大企业买家的竞争。
ex.note: corporate identity 企业形象

ex.en: The farmer milks his cows twice a day, in the morning and evening.
ex.cn: 农夫每天挤两次牛奶，早上一次，晚上一次。
ex.note: a herd of cows 一群牛

ex.en: It would be cruel to punish one student for a single mistake.
ex.cn: 因为一次失误就惩罚一个学生，未免太残酷了。
ex.note: cruel to sb. 对某人残忍

ex.en: The dam holds back a huge reservoir of water.
ex.cn: 这座大坝拦住了大片的水库。
ex.note: build a dam 筑坝

ex.en: The provincial competition is held every December.
ex.cn: 省里那项比赛每年十二月举行。

ex.en: To her delight, the teacher praised her answer in class.
ex.cn: 让她欣喜的是，老师在课上表扬了她的回答。

ex.en: The applause delighted the young team.
ex.cn: 掌声让这个年轻的队伍欣喜不已。
ex.note: with delight 欣喜地；be delighted to do 乐意做

ex.en: He was desperate to finish the report before the deadline.
ex.cn: 他急切地想在截止日期前把报告写完。
ex.note: be desperate for 极需要；be desperate to do 渴望做

ex.en: A balanced diet matters more than any supplement.
ex.cn: 均衡的饮食比任何补剂都重要。

ex.en: She has dieted for three months and feels much better.
ex.cn: 她节食了三个月，感觉好多了。
ex.note: go on a diet 节食；a balanced diet 均衡饮食

ex.en: Please sort the paper and discard the damaged copies.
ex.cn: 请把纸分开归类，把损坏的副本丢掉。
ex.note: discard sth. 丢弃某物

ex.en: Sorry to disturb you, but there is a call for you.
ex.cn: 抱歉打扰你，有人打电话找你。
ex.note: disturb one's peace 扰乱某人的安宁

ex.en: He put the box down on the floor and wiped his hands.
ex.cn: 他把箱子放在地板上，擦了擦手。

ex.en: The old radiator is down again, so we shall be cold.
ex.cn: 那台旧暖气又坏了，看来我们得挨冻。
ex.note: down town 市中心；down and out 一无所有

ex.en: A duck walked across the path and into the reeds.
ex.cn: 一只鸭子穿过小路，走进了芦苇丛。

ex.en: He ducked under the low branch and went on walking.
ex.cn: 他低头钻过低垂的树枝，继续往前走。
ex.note: duck one's head 低下头

ex.en: The company slowed down for economic reasons.
ex.cn: 公司出于经济原因放慢了脚步。
ex.note: economic growth 经济增长；economic crisis 经济危机

ex.en: He took the broken kettle to an electrical repair shop.
ex.cn: 他把那只坏了的水壶拿到一家电器维修店。
ex.note: electrical engineer 电气工程师

ex.en: The bottle was empty and the shelf was bare.
ex.cn: 瓶子空了，架子也空了。

ex.en: They emptied the box of old paper into the bin.
ex.cn: 他们把箱子里的旧纸倒进垃圾桶。
ex.note: empty into 倒入；empty of 缺乏

ex.en: The entrance of the dormitory is on the left of the square.
ex.cn: 宿舍楼的入口在广场左边。
ex.note: entrance to 通往…的入口；make an entrance 登场

ex.en: Every locker has a number painted on the door.
ex.cn: 每个储物柜的门上都漆着编号。
ex.note: every other day 每隔一天；every time 每一次

ex.en: He excused himself and went out for a minute.
ex.cn: 他说了声抱歉，出去了一分钟。

ex.en: There is no excuse for being late again.
ex.cn: 再迟到就找不到任何借口了。
ex.note: make an excuse for 为…找借口

ex.en: She kept extensive notes of every experiment she ran.
ex.cn: 她把每一次实验都详细地记了笔记。
ex.note: extensive research 广泛的调查

ex.en: Stories of the famine years still haunt the old men of the village.
ex.cn: 饥荒年代的故事至今仍萦绕在村里的老人们心头。
ex.note: famine relief 饥荒救济

ex.en: The villagers held a feast to celebrate the harvest.
ex.cn: 村民们办了一场宴席庆祝丰收。
ex.note: a wedding feast 婚宴；a feast for the eyes 视觉上的盛宴

ex.en: We watched a short film about the history of the old bridge.
ex.cn: 我们看了一部关于那座老桥的短片。

ex.en: They filmed the whole experiment on a small camera.
ex.cn: 他们用一台小相机把整个实验拍了下来。
ex.note: film a movie 拍电影；film industry 电影业

ex.en: Dust floated in the sunlight above the old desk.
ex.cn: 旧书桌上方的阳光里，尘埃在浮动。
ex.note: float on 在…上漂浮

ex.en: They learned a great deal from a foreign exchange student.
ex.cn: 他们从一位外国留学生身上学到了很多。
ex.note: foreign language 外语；foreign exchange 交流（生）

ex.en: She gave a frank answer about the risks of the plan.
ex.cn: 她坦率地说出了这个计划的风险。
ex.note: frank with sb. 对某人坦诚

ex.en: The old man told a funny story about a broken radio.
ex.cn: 老人讲了一个关于坏收音机的有趣故事。
ex.note: funny business 奇怪的事；a funny feeling 奇怪的感觉

ex.en: Each generation of students brings new ideas to the club.
ex.cn: 每一代学生都会给社团带来新的想法。
ex.note: generation gap 代沟；the older generation 老一辈

ex.en: A goat escaped from the farm and ate all the vegetables.
ex.cn: 一只山羊从农场跑出来，把菜地啃了个精光。
ex.note: get someone's goat 使某人恼火

ex.en: The graph shows a sharp peak in every December.
ex.cn: 图表显示每年十二月都有一个尖峰。
ex.note: draw a graph 画图表；graph paper 坐标纸

ex.en: The school issued new guidelines for student projects.
ex.cn: 学校为学生项目发布了新的指导方针。
ex.note: issue guidelines 发布准则

ex.en: Many families went through real hardship after the flood.
ex.cn: 洪灾之后，许多家庭经历了真正的困苦。
ex.note: endure hardship 忍受困苦

ex.en: The box was too heavy for one person to lift.
ex.cn: 那个箱子太重，一个人抬不动。
ex.note: heavy rain 大雨；heavy traffic 交通拥堵

ex.en: Her face gave no hint that she was nervous.
ex.cn: 她脸上没有露出一点紧张的痕迹。

ex.en: Could you hint at the answer without telling me directly?
ex.cn: 你能不能暗示一下答案，又不直接告诉我？
ex.note: a hint of 一丝；drop a hint 给暗示

ex.en: She looked in horror at the mess in the laboratory.
ex.cn: 她惊恐地看着实验室里的狼藉。
ex.note: to one's horror 令某人惊恐的是；the horror of 对…的恐惧

ex.en: I could not decide which of the two plans was better.
ex.cn: 我无法决定两个方案中哪个更好。
ex.note: 英文第一人称 I 任何时候都要大写

ex.en: He grew impatient when the reply did not come.
ex.cn: 回音迟迟不来，他渐渐不耐烦起来。
ex.note: impatient for 迫不及待；impatient to do 急着做

ex.en: There was no indication that the system would work.
ex.cn: 没有任何迹象表明这套系统能行得通。
ex.note: an indication of … …的迹象；give indications of 表明

ex.en: The company is known for innovation rather than for advertising.
ex.cn: 这家公司以创新闻名，而不是靠广告。
ex.note: technological innovation 技术创新

ex.en: She had no intention of leaving the project halfway.
ex.cn: 她没有半途丢下这个项目的打算。
ex.note: have the intention of 有…的打算；with the intention of 抱着…的目的

ex.en: The old machine was made of iron and heavy wood.
ex.cn: 那台旧机器是铁和厚木料做的。

ex.en: She ironed the shirts before the interview on Monday.
ex.cn: 周一面试之前，她把衬衫熨好了。
ex.note: iron ore 铁矿石；iron out 熨平、解决

ex.en: In my judgment, the plan needs more time and more money.
ex.cn: 依我判断，这个计划需要更多时间和更多钱。
ex.note: in one's judgment 依某人判断；sound judgment 明智

ex.en: He hurt his knee on the steps of the library.
ex.cn: 他在图书馆的台阶上摔伤了膝盖。
ex.note: on one's knees 跪着

ex.en: Later that week, the first cart went out on the road.
ex.cn: 那周晚些时候，第一辆手推车上了路。
ex.note: later on 稍后；no later than 不迟于

ex.en: Turn left at the second corner and you will see the gate.
ex.cn: 在第二个路口左转，就能看见大门。
ex.note: on the left 在左边；left over 剩下的

ex.en: He enjoys classical music; likewise, his sister plays the violin.
ex.cn: 他喜欢古典音乐，同样地，他姐姐会拉小提琴。
ex.note: likewise = also；in a similar way 同样地

ex.en: She kept a daily log of every book lent out.
ex.cn: 每一本借出去的书，她都记在每日台账上。

ex.en: The driver logs the mileage of every trip by hand.
ex.cn: 司机手工记录每一趟的里程。
ex.note: log in 登录；a daily log 值班日志

ex.en: The company invested in modern machinery for the new factory.
ex.cn: 公司为新工厂投资了先进的机器设备。
ex.note: machinery and equipment 机器设备

ex.en: He drew a map of the campus on a large sheet of paper.
ex.cn: 他在一张大纸上画了一张校园地图。

ex.en: They mapped every stop between the store and the dorms.
ex.cn: 他们把书库与宿舍之间的每一站都标在了图上。
ex.note: map out 规划；on the map 在地图上

ex.en: In the meantime, the numbers began to rise again.
ex.cn: 与此同时，数字又开始回升了。
ex.note: in the meantime 与此同时；for the meantime 暂时

ex.en: The box was made of metal and had a heavy lid.
ex.cn: 那箱子是金属做的，盖子很沉。
ex.note: metal worker 金属工人；scrap metal 废金属

ex.en: The test missile lifted slowly from the launch pad.
ex.cn: 试验导弹缓缓从发射台上升起。
ex.note: missile defence 导弹防御

ex.en: She sat outdoors and was bitten by mosquitoes all evening.
ex.cn: 她坐在户外，整晚都被蚊子叮。
ex.note: mosquito net 蚊帐

ex.en: My first attempt at the plan failed, but I learned a lot from it.
ex.cn: 我最初的方案失败了，可我从中学到了不少东西。
ex.note: my own 我自己的

ex.en: The winter months were a negative result for the business.
ex.cn: 冬季这几个月对这门生意来说是负面的结果。

ex.en: The negative of that old photo is still in the drawer.
ex.cn: 那张老照片的底片还放在抽屉里。
ex.note: a negative result 阴性结果；in the negative 否定地

ex.en: Nobody knew exactly how the new plan would work.
ex.cn: 没有人确切知道新方案会怎么运作。
ex.note: nobody else 没有别人；nobody but 只有…

ex.en: He has made numerous attempts to repair the machine.
ex.cn: 他为了修好这台机器已经尝试了无数次。
ex.note: numerous + 复数名词

ex.en: The new rules must be applied without offense to anyone.
ex.cn: 这些新规则执行起来不能得罪任何人。
ex.note: take offense at 因…生气；an offense to 对…的冒犯

ex.en: His parents remained optimistic about the plan for the shop.
ex.cn: 他父母对这家店子的计划仍然乐观。
ex.note: optimistic about 对…乐观

ex.en: The outlook for small bookshops is not good.
ex.cn: 小书店的前景并不乐观。
ex.note: the outlook for … …的前景；a bleak outlook 前景黯淡

ex.en: They painted the old door a bright yellow.
ex.cn: 他们把那扇旧门漆成了明亮的黄色。

ex.en: Wet paint was still shining on the iron rail.
ex.cn: 铁栏杆上的油漆还没干，亮着光。
ex.note: paint sth. … 把某物涂成…；a coat of paint 一层漆

ex.en: Only sixteen teams passed the first round of the competition.
ex.cn: 只有十六支队伍通过了比赛的第一轮。

ex.en: Show your pass at the gate before you go in.
ex.cn: 进场之前请先出示通行证。
ex.note: pass by 经过；pass sth. to sb. 把某物递给某人

ex.en: Late returns now carry a small penalty.
ex.cn: 逾期归还现在要收取一小笔罚款。
ex.note: a penalty for … 对…的处罚；penalty kick 点球

ex.en: Petroleum and coal are still the main fuels used in this region.
ex.cn: 石油和煤至今仍是这一带使用的主要燃料。
ex.note: petroleum industry 石油工业

ex.en: He put down his pipe and turned to listen to the radio.
ex.cn: 他放下烟斗，转过身来听收音机。
ex.note: a pipe of wine 一杯酒；water pipe 水管

ex.en: Keep this chemical away from children; it is a strong poison.
ex.cn: 这种化学品要远离儿童，它毒性很强。

ex.en: Poisoned food killed hundreds of rats in the warehouse.
ex.cn: 被下了毒的食物毒死了仓库里成百上千只老鼠。
ex.note: poison sb. 毒死某人；poisonous 有毒的

ex.en: She spoke in a positive tone about the new plan for the team.
ex.cn: 她用一种积极的语气谈起新的团队方案。
ex.note: positive result 阳性；be positive about 对…持乐观态度

ex.en: I prefer walking to taking the bus when the weather is fine.
ex.cn: 天气好的时候，比起坐公交，我更愿意走路。
ex.note: prefer A to B 宁愿A胜过B；prefer doing to doing 宁愿…而不愿…

ex.en: They printed a small map and put it on every door.
ex.cn: 他们印了一张小地图，贴在每一扇门上。

ex.en: The sign at the door was nothing but a rough print of her name.
ex.cn: 门口那块牌子不过是她名字的一张粗糙的印刷品。
ex.note: print out 打印；in print 已出版

ex.en: The news prompted a long discussion among the judges.
ex.cn: 这条消息在评委之间引来了长时间的讨论。

ex.en: The head judge gave a prompt answer to the question.
ex.cn: 主评委迅速回答了那个问题。
ex.note: prompt sb. to do 促使某人做；a prompt reply 立即答复

ex.en: She felt her pulse as she waited for the result.
ex.cn: 等待结果的时候，她摸着自己的脉搏。
ex.note: a weak pulse 脉搏微弱；a pulse of … 某种脉动

ex.en: The manager quoted a price of fifty yuan an hour.
ex.cn: 经理报出每小时五十元的价格。

ex.en: He put a quote from an old book at the top of the page.
ex.cn: 他把古书里的一句引文放在页首。
ex.note: quote a price 报价；a direct quotation 直接引语

ex.en: She read the instructions carefully and followed every step.
ex.cn: 她仔细读了说明，然后照着每一步去做。
ex.note: read aloud 朗读；read through 通读

ex.en: They recruited twelve volunteers in three days.
ex.cn: 他们三天里招到了十二名志愿者。

ex.en: Every new recruit had to finish a short training course.
ex.cn: 每一位新成员都得完成一门短期培训课。
ex.note: recruit sb. 招募某人；recruitment 招聘

ex.en: She invited several of her relatives to the ceremony.
ex.cn: 她邀请了好几位亲戚来参加典礼。

ex.en: Compare the figures relative to last year before you decide.
ex.cn: 做决定之前，先把与去年相对的数字比较一下。
ex.note: relative to 相对于；in relative terms 就相对而言

ex.en: A single line in the graph can represent a whole season.
ex.cn: 图上的一条线就能代表一整个季节。
ex.note: represent sb. 代表某人；stand for 象征

ex.en: The children became restless during the long lecture.
ex.cn: 讲座太长，孩子们变得坐立不安。
ex.note: restless energy 不安分的精力；feel restless 感到焦躁

ex.en: Smoke rises from the chimney of the old factory every morning.
ex.cn: 每天早晨，旧工厂的烟囱里都升起炊烟。

ex.en: A sudden rise in costs forced them to rethink the plan.
ex.cn: 成本的突然上涨迫使他们重新思考这个计划。
ex.note: rise to the occasion 随机应变；give rise to 引起

ex.en: What he said at the meeting was complete rubbish.
ex.cn: 他在会上说的完全是一派胡言。
ex.note: a pile of rubbish 一堆垃圾；rubbish talk 废话

ex.en: The weather satellite sends back pictures every hour.
ex.cn: 气象卫星每小时都传回图像。
ex.note: satellite dish 卫星天线；satellite TV 卫星电视

ex.en: The museum invites a scientist to talk to the students each year.
ex.cn: 博物馆每年都请一位科学家来给学生讲座。
ex.note: a leading scientist 一位杰出的科学家

ex.en: She seldom talks about her own difficulties.
ex.cn: 她很少谈起自己的难处。
ex.note: seldom 放在实义动词之前；seldom ever 几乎从不

ex.en: The shop sells several kinds of second-hand textbooks.
ex.cn: 这家店出售好几种二手教科书。
ex.note: several + 复数名词；not several 没有几个

ex.en: A small boat lay anchored near the shore that evening.
ex.cn: 那天傍晚，一条小船停在岸边。
ex.note: on the shore 在岸上；off shore 近海的

ex.en: The problems of the two schools were very similar.
ex.cn: 两所学校的问题非常相似。
ex.note: be similar to 与…相似；a similar case 类似案例

ex.en: The ceremony was held on the top floor of a skyscraper.
ex.cn: 典礼在一座摩天大楼的顶层举行。
ex.note: a forty-storey skyscraper 四十层的摩天大楼

ex.en: The factory was built under the first socialist government of the region.
ex.cn: 这座工厂是在该地区第一个社会主义政府时期建成的。
ex.note: under socialism 在社会主义制度下

ex.en: What sort of book are you looking for?
ex.cn: 你在找哪一类书？

ex.en: She sorted the donated books by subject and by year.
ex.cn: 她把捐来的书按学科和年份分好类。
ex.note: sort out 整理；sort of 有点儿

ex.en: British and American spellings differ in a great many words.
ex.cn: 英式和美式拼写在许多单词上并不相同。
ex.note: spelling mistake 拼写错误；check the spelling 检查拼写

ex.en: She ran down the stairs to catch the last bus.
ex.cn: 她跑下楼梯去赶最后一班公交车。
ex.note: up the stairs 上楼；a flight of stairs 一段楼梯

ex.en: He still lives in the same small flat near the river.
ex.cn: 他仍住在河边那间小公寓里。

ex.en: The lake was perfectly still and grey in the morning.
ex.cn: 清晨的湖面平静得像一面灰色的镜子。
ex.note: still + 句子 仍然；still water 静水

ex.en: Their teacher is strict about homework but fair in marking.
ex.cn: 他们老师对作业要求严格，但打分很公正。
ex.note: strict with sb. 对某人要求严格；strict rules 严格的规定

ex.en: The old heating system suddenly stopped working in the middle of the night.
ex.cn: 夜里那套旧供暖系统突然就不管用了。
ex.note: all of a sudden 突然间

ex.en: I suppose you have already sent the forms to the office.
ex.cn: 我想你应该已经把表格送到办公室了。
ex.note: suppose that … 假设；be supposed to 应该

ex.en: The judge was sympathetic to the students' situation.
ex.cn: 那位评委对学生们的处境抱以同情。
ex.note: be sympathetic to 对…表示同情

ex.en: He spent ten years as a technician in a television factory.
ex.cn: 他在一家电视厂当了十年技术员。
ex.note: a skilled technician 熟练的技术员

ex.en: This is a textbook case of a small business changing its model.
ex.cn: 这是一个小企业改变经营模式的典型案例。
ex.note: a textbook example 典型例子；textbook knowledge 教科书般的知识

ex.en: After the long walk, the children were thirsty and tired.
ex.cn: 走了长路之后，孩子们又渴又累。
ex.note: be thirsty for 渴望；thirsty work 辛苦的工作

ex.en: He waited till midnight before he finally made the call.
ex.cn: 他等到午夜才终于打了那个电话。
ex.note: till = until；up till now 迄今为止

ex.en: The company took the top spot in the regional competition.
ex.cn: 那家公司在地区比赛中取得了第一名。

ex.en: The team was made up of the top students in the college.
ex.cn: 这支队伍由学院里最优秀的学生组成。
ex.note: at the top of 在…的顶端；top price 最高价

ex.en: They transport the books by cart between the store and the dorms.
ex.cn: 他们用手推车在书库与宿舍之间运送这些书。

ex.en: The cost of transport is the biggest problem for them.
ex.cn: 运输成本是他们最大的难题。
ex.note: public transport 公共交通

ex.en: He put the old boxes in the trunk of his car.
ex.cn: 他把那些旧箱子放进了汽车的后备箱里。
ex.note: tree trunk 树干；car trunk 汽车后备箱

ex.en: The books travelled through an underground passage.
ex.cn: 那些书是通过一段地下通道运送的。

ex.en: They took the underground to the other side of the city.
ex.cn: 他们乘地铁去了城的另一边。

ex.en: The old pipes run underground for most of the way.
ex.cn: 这些旧管道大部分路段都埋在地下。
ex.note: go underground 转入地下；underground parking 地下停车场

ex.en: The news upset him more than he had expected.
ex.cn: 这个消息让他比预想的更难受。

ex.en: She was upset about the noise in the office all afternoon.
ex.cn: 整个下午，办公室里的噪音都让她心烦。

ex.en: She complained of a stomach upset after the bad meal.
ex.cn: 吃了那顿难吃的饭后，她抱怨胃不舒服。
ex.note: be upset about 因…而难过；an upset stomach 肠胃不适

ex.en: There is a wide variation in the size of the boxes.
ex.cn: 这些箱子的尺寸差别很大。
ex.note: variations in 在…方面的变化；a variation of … 的变体

ex.en: The two designs are virtually identical.
ex.cn: 这两种设计几乎一模一样。
ex.note: virtually impossible 几乎不可能；virtually every 几乎每个

ex.en: We wandered along the shore until the light went.
ex.cn: 我们在海边漫步，直到天色暗下来。
ex.note: wander off 走神；wander around 四处闲逛

ex.en: The two teams have met three times this week.
ex.cn: 这两支队伍本周已经交手三次了。
ex.note: in a week 一周之后；week after week 周复一周

ex.en: He gave a low whistle of surprise when he heard the news.
ex.cn: 听到这个消息，他低声吹了一声口哨，表示惊讶。

ex.en: The train whistled as it entered the tunnel.
ex.cn: 火车驶进隧道时鸣了笛。
ex.note: whistle at sb. 对某人吹口哨

ex.en: They wrapped the old books with brown paper and string.
ex.cn: 他们用牛皮纸和细绳把那些旧书包好。
ex.note: with + 名词 带有；with the door open 门开着

ex.en: Wrap the glass carefully before you put it in the box.
ex.cn: 把玻璃杯小心包好再放进箱子里。

ex.en: She bought a woollen wrap for the cold winter nights.
ex.cn: 她买了一条羊毛围巾，好过那些寒冷的冬夜。
ex.note: wrap up 包好；a woollen wrap 羊毛围巾
